visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with voluminous dark curly hair and a dark green oversized t-shirt stands before a gray marble vanity in a modern, warmly lit bathroom. He is framed in a medium shot, shaking a black supplement bottle labeled 'CREATINE' onto the counter surface. A large mirror reflects a wall-mounted hairdryer behind him. (2) The man leans down closely over the marble surface, using a small white plastic card to meticulously arrange a pile of white powder into a neat, straight line. He wears a black watch on his left wrist, and a large black tattoo is clearly visible on his right forearm as he focuses on the powder. (3) A very muscular man wearing a tight-fitting gray t-shirt and dark athletic pants suddenly appears in the background through an open doorway. He looks shocked and points his finger aggressively toward the young man, stepping forward into the room with an expression of sudden confrontation. (4) The young man looks up, startled, and immediately blows a sharp burst of air onto the counter, causing a large white cloud of powder to erupt and disperse across the vanity. The muscular man stops in his tracks, his eyes bulging and mouth hanging open in a comedic expression of disbelief. (5) The shot cuts to a close-up of the muscular man's face as he holds a clear shaker bottle containing water. He stares directly into the camera lens with a wide-eyed, stunned expression, while the warm indoor lighting emphasizes his facial contours and the transparent plastic of the bottle.
